title: Lower berth maanga, upper kyun mila?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: Tumne lower berth maanga... mila UPPER!
Bagal wali aunty ko... bina maange LOWER!
[whispers] Raaz: har coach me kuch lower reserved hain.
Seniors, 45 plus auraton ke liye... automatic!
Aise aur railway raaz... follow karo!
caption:
Tumne LOWER berth maanga... mila UPPER. Aur bagal wali aunty ko bina maange LOWER! 😤

Raaz: har coach me kuch lower berths pehle se reserved hoti hain: Sleeper me 6-7, 3AC me 4-5, 2AC me 3-4 (train me us class ke kitne coach hain, uske hisaab se). Ye senior citizens, 45 saal se upar ki mahilaon aur pregnant mahilaon ke liye hain.

Railway Minister ne Rajya Sabha me bataya (Dec 2025): inhe lower berth automatic milti hai, chahe unhone koi choice na di ho, bas khaali honi chahiye. Aur tumhari berth preference bhi sirf "subject to availability" hai, guarantee nahi.

Aur haan, WhatsApp wala "train ka balance/physics" waala gyaan? Railway Board ke member ne kaha tha: berth physics se nahi, passenger ke profile se milti hai. 🚆

Agla railway raaz kya chahiye? Comment karo 👇
